title: Long multi-section description
purpose: Exercise prioritization and evidence quoting with a relatively long input.

listing.title: Modular Home Office Cable Management Kit
bullets: Includes clips, sleeves, reusable ties, and adhesive mounts.
Components can be combined for desks, monitor stands, and charging areas.
Adhesive mounts should be applied to a clean, dry surface.
listing.description: This modular cable management kit is designed for home-office desks and charging stations. The package includes multiple clips for routing individual cords, flexible sleeves for grouping cords, reusable hook-and-loop ties, and adhesive mounts. Users can combine the components according to desk layout. Before applying an adhesive mount, clean and dry the surface. The listing does not specify component counts, sleeve length, supported cable diameter, surface compatibility, replacement adhesive availability, or package dimensions. The same general description is repeated here to simulate a longer merchandising section while preserving the absence of those purchase details: the kit contains clips, sleeves, reusable ties, and adhesive mounts for organizing desk cables.

priority_expectations: Prioritize missing verified package contents and compatibility details

notes: A deterministic unit test separately constructs exact maximum-length boundaries.
